prompt: What should the man do if he wants all three kinds of seeds accepted on Saturday?
promptZh: 如果男子希望三種種子都能在星期六被收下，他應該怎麼做？

options.text: Send two envelopes with the woman, then bring the pumpkin seeds after he completes the label.
options.zh: 先託女子帶兩個信封，補好標籤後再把南瓜種子帶去。
options.whyZh: 兩包已有必要資訊，可先送；南瓜種子須補採收時間，午餐後仍可在三點前帶去。

options.text: Send all three envelopes with the woman and add his neighbor's name to the pumpkin label.
options.zh: 三包都託女子帶去，並把鄰居的姓名加在南瓜標籤上。
options.whyZh: 姓名不是必要資訊，不能代替採收時間。

options.text: Send the pumpkin seeds in the morning and keep the other two until their exact varieties are known.
options.zh: 早上先送南瓜種子，等查明另外兩包的確切品種再帶去。
options.whyZh: 規定不要求品種，反而是南瓜種子缺了採收時間。

options.text: Wait for the swap to end, then give all three envelopes to the woman.
options.zh: 等交換會結束，再把三個信封都交給女子。
options.whyZh: 活動三點結束；等到結束後便無法於交換會交件。

explanationZh: 兩包已有必要資訊，可先送；南瓜種子須補採收時間，午餐後仍可在三點前帶去。
evidence: The beans and basil have both details. | each envelope has to say the kind of plant and the month and year the seeds were collected. | Give me the other two before I leave. Your neighbor should be back around noon, so you can ask her about the pumpkin seeds then. The swap goes on until three. | I won't get there until after lunch. | I know they're pumpkin seeds, but I didn't ask when she collected them.

vocabulary.note: go on 指活動持續進行，不是表示活動三點開始。
